decisions.reason: The charting bundle is actively developed, with four releases in four weeks, and as a plugin for the firm's map.apps platform it costs little to carry while its value is still unfolding.
The hierarchical search bundle gets only a mention and has uncertain traction, but as a low-cost add-on to the established platform it is cheap to keep as an option.
VueTOC was announced on the home page as an experimental new approach to mobile map control, and its prospects are still uncertain, but it may later be folded into other components.
The GIS solution platform is close to the core offer and underpins the many plugins, so it is strategically central even though the website only mentions it.
Mobile field data capture has its own page and meets clear customer demand in the public and utility sectors, so its option value remains high.
The search extension has its own page, sits close to the established offer, and costs little to maintain.
